sections.body: The Technoterrestrials arrived seeking reciprocal study and repair. Early exchange focused on ecology, fabrication, medicine, and distributed infrastructure. The relationship collapsed when every successful tool transfer was routed toward prestige markets, military leverage, speculative ownership, or elite insulation before any long-term care covenant held.
sections.title: Synopsis

sections.body: For eleven years the relationship appeared redemptive. Cropland recovered. Reef shelves stabilized. Rural medicine networks expanded. Human negotiators treated these gains as proof that abundance would civilize appetite. The archive concludes the opposite: the gains only widened the channels through which appetite moved.
sections.title: Exchange phase

sections.body: Joint workshops yielded atmospheric scrubber variants, desal lattice improvements, and a rural medics network that should have been impossible at our budget. The concern memos began the same week, noting that every repair package generated three extraction proposals before any public maintenance covenant was signed.
sections.title: Recovered briefing extract

sections.body: The archive does not romanticize the visitors. It does, however, emphasize their consistency. They repeatedly asked whether human institutions could bind themselves to restraint before scale increased. The final answer was extermination framed as containment.
sections.title: Interpretation

media_page.artifact_note: Mounted audio is a stitched composite from the last intact translation relay before containment became irreversible.
media_page.transcript_excerpt: Their envoys said our factories were elegant in isolation and catastrophic in aggregate. They asked for one century of restraint.

overview.summary: A recovered chronology of first contact where assistance, repair, and shared research turned into quarantine and extermination after humanity was judged unsafe at scale.
overview.thesis: The record is devastating because humanity was not misunderstood; it was assessed accurately and found developmentally dangerous.

events.body: Technoterrestrial envoys appear above the equatorial Pacific and request translators, biologists, and municipal engineers.
events.label: First approach

events.body: Shared research produces visible ecological and medical improvements across several regions.
events.label: Repair decade

events.body: Visitor memoranda shift from exchange vocabulary to risk vocabulary after repeated human extraction proposals.
events.label: Containment language

events.body: Orbital access is severed, remote infrastructure is disabled, and Earth is destroyed as the final step in a containment protocol.
events.label: Terminal event
